edit.subject: divides
edit.scope: Whether one positive integer dividing a different positive integer means the second also divides the first.

cross_lingual.prompt: 3 divide a 12. ¿Se deduce que 12 divide a 3?

derived.prompt: 3 divides 12. Does it follow that 12 divides 3?
7 divides 49. Does it follow that 49 divides 7?
